Bond was set based on the number of charges and severity of the allegations, with conditions determined during court proceedings. Authorities say the case developed after repeated allegations of mistreatment inside the daycare, where infants were reportedly handled in a dangerous and aggressive manner. The investigation uncovered a pattern of behavior supported by video evidence, confirming that the incidents were not isolated and occurred over an extended period. Although the suspect was arrested following the investigation, charges in the case were later dropped in December 20. The Department of Children and Families became involved, requiring corrective measures and oversight at the facility moving forward. This case highlights how critical early reporting and immediate action are in child care environments, where delays in response can allow harmful behavior to continue unchecked.
